legacy.name: IBDP 2026 — modernisation capital subsidy

legacy.name: IBDP 2026 — net SGST reimbursement

legacy.benefit: Reimbursement of 75% of eligible net SGST for the chosen eligibility period, within annual and overall incentive ceilings; expansion is assessed on incremental sales.

legacy.access: Apply and submit tax evidence through Invest Punjab/DIC under the DSOG.

legacy.bestFor: Eligible new units and qualifying expansions
